body_markdown:
Aside from the hundreds of feature vehicles that spark our imagination for our own project cars, SEMA also offers a showcase for a wide variety of new tools. Plenty of booths cater to commercial shops, and while some of our favorites in this list are on the aspirational side and may favor those professionals, these tools would be welcome additions to most home shops.


## [Milwaukee M18 Fuel Striker Hammer Chisel](https://www.milwaukeetool.com/products/details/m18-fuel-striker-hammer-chisel/3771-20)


MSRP $599


Air hammers are versatile tools. They can be used to shear sheet metal, cut rivets, split ball joints, and knock out bearings, just to list a few. Unfortunately, their air consumption is just a bit high, requiring a sizable air compressor. That makes them a no-go for plenty of home garages without the space or budget for a big compressor and the necessary plumbing. Now Milwaukee has taken pneumatic power out of the equation with an 18V cordless option, pictured at the top of the page. It’s priced a bit higher than a premium air-powered unit, and a lot more than an entry-level model, but the convenience of being cordless and the cost savings of not relying on an air compressor is huge. Many of the DIYers here at Hagerty have placed a[cordless impact gun and cordless ratchet](https://www.hagerty.com/media/lists/8-tools-were-thankful-for/) at the top of our personal lists of game-changing tools, and the Milwaukee Striker might be a new contender.


## [Gearwrench Hi-Viz Wrenches](https://www.gearwrench.com/all-tools/wrenches/combination-wrenches)


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


MSRP: Varies by set


With lots of well-stocked toolboxes among us, we’re not looking for another excuse to buy a fresh set of combination wrenches. Still, Gearwrench is making is compelling reason for those building out their arsenal to consider their tools with its new Hi-Viz markings. Everyone can relate to grabbing the wrong wrench because of a misidentified size ( *and a few of us have put off glasses for a bit too long—EE)* . Gearwrench’s new Hi-Viz markings make things much clearer, and they’re tested to hold up to brake fluid, solvents, and abrasion. They’re available individually or in sets with pre-cut foam trays to speed toolbox organization.


## [Powerbuilt Kick Tech Lug Wrench](https://www.powerbuilt.com/products/kicktech-high-leverage-speedy-lug-wrench)


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


MSRP: $99


Roadside flats are a lot less common than they used to be. Still, if you push your tires to their limits off-road, or if you’ve ever used the factory tire-changing equipment, this one might hit home. Powerbuilt’s newest lug wrench packs into a small case and contains a pair of universal sockets that fit 11/16”, ¾”, 13/16”, 7/8”, 17mm, 19mm, and 21mm lugs to cover your vehicle and just about anyone else you travel with. It offers a wide aluminum pedal as a sturdy place to step on to get enough torque to break lugs loose, and the locking joints that allow it to collapse into a compact space also let it turn into a speed wrench to spin lugs quickly.


## Icon Straight Metric Feeler Gauge Blade Set


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


MSRP: TBA


Harbor Freight gave SEMA attendees a sneak peek at some of the Icon-branded tools it’s developing for 2027. Its upcoming feeler gauge set includes removable blades and handles that allow the ones needed for the job to be mounted and at the ready. If you’ve ever lashed valves and had to constantly switch back and forth between two feeler gauges, you’ve probably wished for a solution like this.


## [Thieman Quality Products Twister Jr. Engine Stand](https://www.thiemanqualityproducts.com/products/twister-junior-engine-stand)


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


MSRP: $1,249.99


Using a low-buck engine stand to rebuild an engine can be a major chore. Most only come with options for rotating a block at 90-degree intervals, and there’s no easy way to get them to any of those four cardinal points anyway. Theiman Quality Products had their new Twister Jr. engine stand on display with a bare engine block bolted on. Its gear-reduction setup made it easy to rotate the engine to access it from any angle. With a 1000-pound capacity, it’s sturdy enough for most passenger car and light truck engines, and there are adapters to mount all sorts of blocks and heads. If you need more capacity, Thieman also offers the Twister and Mr. Twister stands with capacities of 2500 pounds and 5000 pounds, respectively. The Twister Jr. starts shipping in February 2027.


## [Roadtek 2T Battery-Operated Hydraulic Shop Crane](https://www.shoproadtek.com/)


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


MSRP: $799.99


Removing and installing a vehicle’s powertrain is a delicate procedure that either involves careful communication with a helper or a lot of readjusting of your shop crane to line up the engine mounts on your own. Roadtek already offers a line of battery-powered hydraulic floor jacks. Its new battery-powered hydraulic shop crane seems like it could save a lot of time swapping engines thanks to its remote-control operation. It could also make loading heavy projects into a pickup bed a whole lot easier. If we had one in our shop, we’d also probably find plenty of ways to put it to use. This one’s also coming in 2027.
